author: eula

variants.name: B0
variants.change: Required naive baseline: BeautifulSoup text, RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter, metadata, whitespace BM25 top 5, empty parser, always retrieve.

variants.name: V1
variants.change: Convert tables into text with row labels, column labels and captions.

variants.name: V2
variants.change: Replace fixed splitting with section and table boundary aware chunks and short contextual headers.

variants.name: V3
variants.change: Parse company, question year and document type, then filter the candidate set using document coverage.

variants.name: V4
variants.change: Normalize financial word forms and a fixed vocabulary of financial synonyms for lexical ranking.

variants.name: V5
variants.change: Allocate comparison results across all requested companies.

variants.name: V6
variants.change: Reject questions whose required content words lack support in the eligible documents.

evaluation: Use the provided scorer and fixed generator for each version in a fresh process; keep raw results, context records, logs, token counts and timings.
limitations: Public development data guides improvements. The private set remains unseen. A single temperature-zero run per variant describes this public evaluation; hosted model responses may vary.
